latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Client Onboarding Checklist Generator skill.
- Generates a comprehensive, customizable onboarding checklist for any service business.
- Covers all major phases: Pre-Onboarding, Kick-Off, Setup & Configuration, Stabilization, and Handoff to Ongoing.
- Requests key context from the user (business type, service, client size, timeline) to tailor the checklist.
- Adjusts checklist details based on industry (SaaS, Consulting, Managed Services, Agencies).
- Outputs as a markdown checklist, ready to use in any project management tool.
